status: bounded scratch candidate; not a general AC1027 writer qualification
authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 20.1, 20.4.59 (VIEW CONTROL) and 20.4.61 (UCS CONTROL). The zero count encoding does not distinguish BL from BS; this observation does not qualify nonzero counts.
observation: In a physical ODA-produced AC1027 LINE drawing, both empty controls have a zero absent-string marker at body bit 34 and handles beginning at bit 35. Previous generated frames inserted a separate aligned empty-string trailer and began handles at bit 64. The candidate uses the already-emitted marker and preserves the unaligned handle stream only for the validated empty reserved controls.
scope: AC1027 reserved VIEW_CONTROL and UCS_CONTROL, exact object type/self handle, empty count, no EED/reactors/data storage/extension dictionary, and validated null owner/extension dictionary handle roles. Populated controls, other types, and other revisions retain existing framing. The exact profile refuses a custom-class ledger collision.

wire.qualification: Source null extension dictionary handle is omitted; generated includes explicit role-3 null. Both physical role observations are checked, rather than claimed byte-identical.

implementation: The exact frame path validates the full prologue, marker and handle roles before merging. It restores frame bytes, map and identity entries and generation on tested one-shot allocation failures. A narrowly scoped compound checkpoint also covers later control-handle registration in both emitControlObject overloads; rollback can invalidate a previous last-frame receipt and does not promise to restore it. Failures latch; the direct writer is not claimed reusable after latch. A separate whole-file failed-write/same-facade retry control is included. Persistent allocator failure during rollback is not qualified.
oda_result: For this controlled diagnostic only, byte 0x0b of each generated DWG was changed from 0 to 6 to reach ODA audit; it is distinct from application maintenance byte 0x12 and is not a proposed production change. ODA audit reports 18 warnings before and 16 after; the VIEW and UCS table warnings disappear. Both files still fail at LAYER, require recovery, and produce no DXF. This does not establish whole-file acceptance or semantic equivalence.
binding_limits: The separately hash-bound decompressed objects pages were extracted using the in-tree decompressor; the DWG-to-page lineage is a manually observed join, not independently established by the audit script. LibreDWG supplies independent decoded body boundary, roles and CRC observations; the auditor checks the supplied page bits and hashes. No fixture is added.
compatibility: Generated AC1024 and AC1032 LINE outputs are byte-identical to pre-candidate outputs: SHA-256 53f46e21906c9e18f4f7a499a40a2135d3015325c33f996d2fbcc4e6a046f468 and 94c7f0479c2e17c2266b7aad5b77bc86923f9b2ed20241b536c5ee010b624723 respectively. A populated AC1027 control retains the old path.

tests.coverage: Exact marker/role/CRC/frame receipt and padding, malformed profile refusals, class collision, old revisions and populated fallback; one-shot allocation sweeps for both controls and both emit overloads, empty and prepopulated state; same-facade whole-write retry; fixture-free peer-auditor negatives.

next_step: Investigate the remaining AC1027 LAYER framing/graph failure separately with producer spans and controlled ODA and independent peer checks; do not extrapolate this exact empty-control profile to other objects or AC1032.
